name: unified_content_guard
label: Unified Content Guard
description: Unified safety node filtering PII, profanity, and custom keywords across system, tenant, and workflow scopes.

user_properties.label: Enable PII Redaction
user_properties.description: Masks personally identifiable information (emails, names, phone numbers).

user_properties.label: Enable Profanity Filtering
user_properties.description: Blocks offensive, inappropriate, and unsafe language.

user_properties.label: PII Entities to Redact
user_properties.description: Comma-separated list of Presidio entities to detect.

user_properties.label: PII Score Threshold
user_properties.description: Confidence score threshold (0.0 to 1.0) for PII detection.

user_properties.label: Additional Profane Words
user_properties.description: Additional comma-separated profane words to redact.

user_properties.label: Additional Sensitive Keywords
user_properties.description: Additional comma-separated sensitive keywords to redact.

user_properties.label: Filter Mode
user_properties.description: Select whether to scan all fields, target specific fields, or exclude specific fields.

user_properties.label: Target Fields
user_properties.description: Comma-separated list of target fields to include or exclude (e.g., query, response).

system_properties.label: System Baseline Profanities
system_properties.default: fuck, shit, asshole, bitch, cunt, bastard
